theorems.name: Submission.dgcr_stc_setIntegral_mul_eq_zero_of_uniform_approx
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (K : Set (Euclid n)) (G f : Euclid n → ℝ) (C : ℝ), MeasurableSet K → IntegrableOn G K volume → AEStronglyMeasurable f (volume.restrict K) → (∀ x ∈ K, |f x| ≤ C) → (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ g : Euclid n → ℝ, AEStronglyMeasurable g (volume.restrict K) ∧ (∀ x ∈ K, |f x - g x| ≤ ε) ∧ ∫ x in K, G x * g x = 0) → ∫ x in K, G x * f x = 0
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
